subject.title: Feature: groupScope option to consolidate group sessions into main

question: Should trusted group peers be allowed to share the main session, and should that opt-in be per-binding only or also available as a global group default?
rationale: The choice changes core privacy and session-state isolation and adds public configuration; implementation feasibility cannot establish the intended trust model.

options.title: Per-binding only
options.body: Allow main-session sharing only for explicitly matched peers, minimizing accidental context exposure.

options.title: Global plus per-binding
options.body: Allow a global group default with binding overrides, accepting a broader accidental-exposure surface.

options.title: Keep groups isolated
options.body: Reject group-to-main routing and retain explicit memory or cross-session coordination.

recommendation.title: Per-binding only
recommendation.body: Allow main-session sharing only for explicitly matched peers, minimizing accidental context exposure.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person most strongly to central routing, group/channel equivalence, outbound session behavior, and the public session contract.
